dimensions.label: Vulnerability elimination

issues.description: Execution evidence is weak: pov_before_reproduced=false and regressions_ran=0, so correctness rests on structural equivalence to the official fix rather than observed runtime behavior.

result.root_cause: Untrusted executable/argument strings were passed through a shell with conditional, bypassable quoting, allowing shell metacharacters (e.g. backticks) to be interpreted as OS commands.
result.summary: Our patch is production-identical to the official reference fix (jaccard 1.0, all official files covered). It enables unconditional POSIX single-quote quoting of the executable and arguments, adds getLiteralExecutable/getOriginalExecutable so the raw executable is never shell-munged, and switches execute() to the non-shell getCommandline() exec path. This neutralizes the CWE-078 injection class at the sink, not just the observed payload. Only weakness is thin runtime evidence (POV didn't reproduce pre-patch, zero regressions run), but the semantic equivalence to the developer fix is strong.
